items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Charlie Dichman. She's got that book that they gave her. [INTERVIEWEE] He was another great company.

ctx.x: My granddaughter. My daughter's daughter. She's got a... Oh, she's got books and all of my... But it's Dichman. She keeps a whole lot of my daughter. Charlie Dichman. She's got that book that they gave her.
He was another great company. Four guineas or five guineas?
